summary: This informational document describes features and use cases of an MPLS path monitoring system. Segment-based routing offers a scalable and simple way to check the liveness of all the paths in one domain. The system adds features to traditional MPLS monitoring.

eli5.summary: A security guard walks every corridor to check each is open. This describes a scalable way to do that for a network's paths.

questions: how to monitor mpls data plane liveness
what is a topology-aware mpls monitoring system
